"We don’t owe anyone our story of assault or abuse...What is most important, is to prioritise our own healing journey." 

Read more in our guide for survivors on 'Telling someone about what happened', hosted by our YSM project, at https://t.co/lYrmjCQFWr. #MeToo https://t.co/2pd3cJqPIH

Spotlight on another YSM guide! This time, 'Taking care of your body after assault':

"Being aware of every feeling in our body is at the foundation of our emotional healing and recovery."

Read more about relearning safety and trust in your body at https://t.co/w6Lx9duVCH #MeToo https://t.co/GhkIyOFZP0

Continuing with our "Good Friend Guide" posts, here are some tips on offering support to a friend who is experiencing abuse.

Read more of The Friend Guide by visiting our Projects on our website https://t.co/CBVDkwaPkS .

#MeToo #DomesticViolence #DomesticAbuse #Abuse https://t.co/w1Mu9KMF2v

More advice from our Good Friend Guide! This time on 'What to say' to a loved one experiencing abuse: 
~Discuss how your friend feels.
~Help them clarify & interpret what has happened.
~Explore the power imbalance abusers create.

Read more at: https://t.co/6WLhITPiot
#MeToo https://t.co/iKjvvAx4qu

Heartwrenching accounts from many women this morning. The survivor accounts detail love bombing, gaslighting and extreme coercive control. Manipulators create situations to build trust & then torture and abuse their victims. #metoo
https://t.co/ReqKzg7DpC

We've covered many of these tactics in our guides such as making you feel small, wrong, mentally unstable, like you're blowing things out of proportion and that no one will believe you or love you apart from the abuser. This is NOT true. #MeToo 
https://t.co/VeYvM2lKOH

Abusers use legal notices and gagging to bully survivors into keeping quiet as another tool of coercion thus prolonging the impact of the abuse and PTSD - even after they have left. #metoo https://t.co/9tqPmd7IgC
We've covered #LoveBombing on this instagram post. #metoo https://t.co/g8F9BKoDPk
In this https://t.co/i1bwdLaQoC resource, we break down rape myths which cause us to question our experiences and believe master manipulators. #metoo https://t.co/nlPZg5LFvC

If you're reading these survivor accounts and have never told anyone if the same happened to you, we've put together a guide on https://t.co/i1bwdLaQoC to help you plan it (we know it can be hard). #metoo https://t.co/lYrmjCQFWr

This article runs through things one may feel or go through after being sexually assaulted, mentally and physically.
We have taken into account different scenarios & tried our best to put down tips to assist you through this process. #metoo https://t.co/w6Lx9duVCH

The way people are trying to discredit @AOC shows you why survivors don't come forward. There's no winning the public's heart. Don't come forward? You have a duty to say something. Be strong. Say something? Attention seeker. Lier. Why now? Survivors deserve better! #metoo
